lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a regular spacing with a slight reduction in diameter as they approach the dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a matrix-like pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A well-defined longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-reflectance highlights on the dorsal surface and distinct shadows on the ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated more heavily toward the leading edge and the base, with smaller, less-defined spots near the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of six remoras is visible in the ventral-posterior area relative to the left pectoral fin, creating high-contrast silhouettes against the water column.
